findings.issue: The parenthetical “composition changes” makes a composition change universal for every chemical change, whereas the reference and CED say new substances are formed, typically with different compositions. As standard chemistry, processes such as isomerization can produce a new substance without changing the overall elemental composition. Use “new substances form, typically with different compositions,” or omit the parenthetical.
findings.evidence: REFERENCE vocabulary: “substances are transformed into new substances, typically with different compositions.” CED 4.1 likewise says “typically with different composition.”
